articles.title: Arm Sinks 9% as Chip Selloff Deepens; Qualcomm Drops 6%, Marvell Slides 5%
articles.description: Arm is dropping nearly twice as hard as its closest chip peers, and the reason goes well beyond inflation fears and profit taking. A $25 billion loan tied directly to Arm's share price gives SoftBank a stake in every tick lower.
